items.title: Franklin Templeton Brazil Trims Risk, Sees No Changes With Lula
items.teaser: Franklin Templeton Brazil is cutting risk across its portfolio on expectations that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s new administration won’t bring about the changes investors see as key to improve the nation’s finances.

items.title: UAE Energy Contractor NMDC Plans December Acquisition, CEO Says
items.teaser: Energy and marine services company NMDC Group PJSC aims to announce an acquisition next month as the Middle Eastern company looks to boost growth after the war caused a slump in its regional business, said Chief Executive Officer Yasser Zaghloul.

items.title: Hedge Funds Ask SEC, CFTC to Go Slow in Push to 24/7 Trading
items.teaser: The Trump administration should proceed slowly in the ramp up to round-the-clock trading, the Managed Funds Association said in a letter sent Tuesday to US government regulators.

items.title: Tribunal Finds Emerge Canada Mismanaged Cathie Wood-Linked ETFs
items.teaser: The failed investment firm that sold Toronto-listed versions of Cathie Wood’s exchange-traded funds took self-dealing loans, maintained improper records and failed to act in the best interest of its funds, Canada’s top securities regulator ruled.

items.title: Goldman, Citi Among Banks in $270 Million Stablecoin Backing
items.teaser: A group of financial firms including Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Citigroup Inc., Banco Santander SA and Deutsche Bank AG have committed around $270 million in funding toward a joint stablecoin venture, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: JPMorgan Eyes Big Discount to Get Software Debt Off Banks’ Books
items.teaser: Banks led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. could offer one of the year’s biggest discounts to sell some of the $5 billion in debt for software firm Qualtrics International Inc. that the underwriters were stuck holding a few months ago.
